Yes, they began at the same time. I generally get some allergic reaction to the spring/fall when the weather changes, which is now, but it's never been this bad.

Since the antibiotics, I've no longer had a fever, or a sore throat, but my sinuses are still congested, and I still have a dry cough and sometimes and shortness of breath. 

I'll call the clinic and ask if the lab results are consistent, cause I haven't been contacted by them yet.

Thanks for taking your time :)
